reviewFocus.en: Inspect authorization middleware, resolved dependencies and forwarded-header trust. Merely having a proxy is insufficient; test the real ingress configuration. No exploit experiment was performed for this draft.
reviewFocus.ko: 인가 미들웨어·실제 의존성·전달 헤더 신뢰 설정을 확인할 것을 제안합니다. 프록시 존재만으로 보호를 단정할 수 없으므로 실제 진입 경로 설정을 검토해야 합니다. 이 초안에서 공격 실험을 수행하지 않았습니다.

en.title: BadHost: Starlette path-based authorization and proxy conditions

claims.text: The researchers explain that Starlette reconstructed a URL from an unvalidated Host header while routing used the actual request path. Authorization based on the reconstructed path could therefore disagree with the routed endpoint.

evidence.quote: routing in Starlette is based on the actual request path.
does not perform any validation of the Host header value.

claims.text: The researcher advisory lists affected Starlette versions as >= 0.8.3 and < 1.0.1, and identifies 1.0.1 as patched. Applicability still depends on the application’s path-based security decisions.

evidence.quote: Confirmed Affected Versions: starlette >= 0.8.3, < 1.0.1 Confirmed Patched Versions: starlette 1.0.1

followUp.text: At review time, the maintainer advisory says a proxy or load balancer mitigates this only if it rejects or normalizes malformed Host headers before forwarding and the application does not trust attacker-controlled host headers elsewhere.

evidence.quote: mitigated only if that proxy rejects or normalizes the malformed Host header before forwarding

ko.title: BadHost의 Starlette 경로 기반 인가 문제와 프록시 조건

claims.text: 연구진은 Starlette가 검증하지 않은 Host 헤더로 URL을 재구성하는 반면 라우팅은 실제 요청 경로를 사용한다고 설명한다. 재구성한 경로를 기준으로 인가하면 실제로 실행되는 엔드포인트와 판단이 어긋날 수 있다.

evidence.quote: routing in Starlette is based on the actual request path.
does not perform any validation of the Host header value.

claims.text: 연구진 권고는 Starlette 영향 버전을 >= 0.8.3 및 < 1.0.1로, 수정 버전을 1.0.1로 제시한다. 실제 영향 여부는 애플리케이션이 경로에 근거해 보안 판단을 하는지와 함께 확인해야 한다.

evidence.quote: Confirmed Affected Versions: starlette >= 0.8.3, < 1.0.1 Confirmed Patched Versions: starlette 1.0.1

followUp.text: 검토 시점의 유지보수자 권고는 프록시나 로드밸런서가 잘못된 Host 헤더를 전달 전에 거부·정규화하고 애플리케이션이 다른 경로에서도 공격자 제어 호스트 헤더를 신뢰하지 않는 조건에서만 완화를 설명한다.

evidence.quote: mitigated only if that proxy rejects or normalizes the malformed Host header before forwarding

approval.basis: Codex conversation: user instructed 진행해줘 after reviewing the completion report for Draft PR 34; proceed with publication of eight reviewed drafts while retaining two holds.
